115K likes, 1,605 comments - avec_alan on October 1, 2026: "Some things can wait.
Your health can’t.

Taking care of yourself isn’t only about what happens when something goes wrong.
It’s about listening to your body, your mind, and making the right choices for your health, every day.

That’s why I’m proud to partner with @avec_alan : prevention insurance that helps you take care of your health before you need care, and supports you when you do.

In sickness and in health.

Health Can’t Wait.".
